verdict.rationale: Asana documents its own App Directory (asana.com/apps), which lists many first-party and partner integrations: Slack, Jira, GitHub, GitLab, Figma, Notion, Zapier, Salesforce-connected workflow tools, Stripe and more. However, the evidence shows only a few dozen listed apps, and nothing confirms the 'thousands of third-party tools' scale the story names. missing for 10: evidence of marketplace scale (thousands of apps), documentation of the in-product install/connect flow for workspace admins, independent or hands-on corroboration of marketplace breadth.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can connect my workspace to thousands of third-party tools via an app marketplace

citations.quote: Many apps in our App Directory create Asana tasks and kick start workflow from other tools.
Connect Asana with Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Zendesk, GitHub, GitLab, monday.com, Wrike, or another Asana project.
Connect Asana with the software tools you rely on and let Zapier do the manual, repetitive tasks so you don't have to.
Turn ideas, work requests, and action items from Slack into trackable tasks and comments in Asana.
Create robust, scalable workflows connecting Asana with tools like Salesforce, Google Workspace, Zendesk, and more.
